name: newDevices
description: Devices first added to Device42 during the timeframe, up to 5,000 rows

getArgs.value: {{ (() => { const ids = (sel) => [].concat(sel || []).map((o) => Number([].concat(o.rawId)[0])).filter((n) => Number.isInteger(n)); const where = []; const b = ids(typeof building === 'undefined' ? [] : building); if (b.length) where.push('d.calculated_building_fk in (' + b.join(',') + ')'); const c = ids(typeof customer === 'undefined' ? [] : customer); if (c.length) where.push('d.customer_fk in (' + c.join(',') + ')'); const r = ids(typeof rack === 'undefined' ? [] : rack); if (r.length) where.push('d.calculated_rack_fk in (' + r.join(',') + ')'); const t = [].concat(typeof deviceType === 'undefined' ? [] : deviceType).map((x) => (x && x.value) || x)[0] || ''; if (['physical', 'virtual', 'cluster', 'blade', 'other', 'unknown'].includes(t)) where.push("d.type = '" + t + "'"); where.push("d.first_added >= '" + new Date(timeframe.start).toISOString() + "'"); where.push("d.first_added < '" + new Date(timeframe.end).toISOString() + "'"); return 'select d.device_pk as device_id, d.name, d.type, d.os_name as os, b.name as building, c.name as customer, d.first_added' + ' from view_device_v2 d left join view_hardware_v2 h on h.hardware_pk = d.hardware_fk left join view_vendor_v1 v on v.vendor_pk = h.vendor_fk left join view_customer_v1 c on c.customer_pk = d.customer_fk left join view_building_v1 b on b.building_pk = d.calculated_building_fk left join view_room_v1 r on r.room_pk = d.calculated_room_fk left join view_rack_v1 k on k.rack_pk = d.calculated_rack_fk where ' + where.join(' and ') + ' order by d.first_added desc limit 5000'; })() }}
